# GMG Visual

> GMG Visual is a creative studio in Hội An, Vietnam. It offers photography, videography, Google Maps 360° virtual tours, websites and social media content for hotels, restaurants and brands in Hội An, Da Nang and across Vietnam. Led by Gianmarco Maccabruno Giometti, formerly Lafresia Media Productions.

## Services
- Photography: food and hospitality, events, portraits
- Videography
- Google Maps 360° virtual tours and 360° photography
- Websites and digital solutions
- Social media content
